# matilda. — Complete Catalog & Brand Manifest

## Overview
Matilda is an artisanal jewelry and accessory house based in the valley. We reject disposable fast-fashion and synthetic plated alloys, focusing exclusively on solid sterling silver, authentic freshwater pearls, and tactile heirloom accessories.

## Catalog Details

### 1. HEAVY SILVER CHAIN
- **Category**: Jewelry / Chains
- **Collection**: Women & Unisex
- **Price**: ₹3,800 INR
- **Material**: Solid 925 Sterling Silver
- **Specifications**: 16", 18", 20" lengths; heavy solid lobster clasp; hand-finished link by link.
- **Description**: Simple heavy silver chain forged in our valley studio to rest cold on skin. Solid weight that stays clean and real.

### 2. SOLID SILVER SIGNET
- **Category**: Jewelry / Rings
- **Collection**: Men & Women
- **Price**: ₹2,800 INR
- **Material**: Solid 925 Sterling Silver
- **Specifications**: Sizes US 7, 8, 9, 10, 11; mirror-polished flat face suitable for custom engraving; weighty shank.
- **Description**: Monolithic signet cast in solid 925 silver. Minimalist presence with comfortable interior comfort fit.

### 3. TEXTURED CUFF BRACELET
- **Category**: Jewelry / Bracelets
- **Collection**: Men & Unisex
- **Price**: ₹4,200 INR
- **Material**: Solid 925 Sterling Silver
- **Specifications**: M / L sizes; hand-hammered chiseled texture; semi-flexible cuff for customized contouring.
- **Description**: Forged silver cuff bearing organic hammer facets that catch soft ambient light.

### 4. BAROQUE FRESHWATER PEARL CHOKER
- **Category**: Jewelry / Necklaces
- **Collection**: Women
- **Price**: ₹3,200 INR
- **Material**: Genuine Freshwater Baroque Pearls + Solid 925 Clasp
- **Specifications**: 15" with 2" silver extender; individually hand-knotted on pure silk thread.
- **Description**: Naturally irregular baroque pearls with organic luster. No two pearls are alike.

### 5. SCULPTURAL SILVER HOOPS
- **Category**: Jewelry / Earrings
- **Collection**: Women
- **Price**: ₹2,400 INR
- **Material**: Solid 925 Sterling Silver
- **Specifications**: 22mm diameter; hollow-cast for comfortable day-long wear; secure click-top closure.
- **Description**: Bold, fluid silver hoops sculpted with undulating curves.

## Ordering & Fulfillment Policy
- All orders receive instant order tracking numbers (e.g. MT-8421).
- Dispatches occur within 24 hours of order confirmation.
- Pan-India express delivery arrives in 3–5 business days.
- 100% solid sterling silver verification certificate included in every delivery.
